'''Anyarah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprenticed to [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Pharshol]]. Anyarah died [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] made [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] its capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Her spirit possessed a Sith Master after Lord [[Aloysius Kallig|Kallig's]] awakening by explorers of the [[Dark Temple]].
